set.body:
Source: review of Identifiers.scala and build compiler options.

Problem:
identifier companions repeat boilerplate; strict equality is not enabled; opaque identifiers lack companion CanEqual/Eq/Order/Show instances; library constants use fold(throw) escape hatches.

Acceptance:
- Consolidate shared validated-text behavior behind a Scala 3 path-dependent TextIdentifier abstraction or an equally type-safe design.
- Enable -language:strictEquality across published modules and fix all resulting comparisons intentionally.
- Provide lawful CanEqual plus Cats Eq/Order/Show instances in identifier companions.
- Provide a clearly named controlled unsafeFrom for trusted library/test constants; evaluate inline literal validation where it improves APIs.
- Remove internal fold(throw), toOption.get, and value-based hand-sorting made unnecessary by these instances.
set.title: P6f.11: Complete identifier and strict-equality discipline
